title: 只读复核：空串/NULL 同列对照、tinyint 越界、boolean 存储类、中文排序、复合 UNIQUE 落库

steps.label: 空串与 NULL 同列对照（c_u 列同时含两类值）
steps.sql: SELECT id, tag, c_u IS NULL AS is_null, length(c_u) AS len, typeof(c_u) AS cls, quote(c_u) AS quoted FROM probe_nn ORDER BY id

steps.label: c_u 列：NULL 与空串计数
steps.sql: SELECT sum(c_u IS NULL) AS cnt_null, sum(c_u = '') AS cnt_empty, count(*) AS total FROM probe_nn

steps.label: tinyint 写 300 后的落库值与存储类（是否拦越界）
steps.sql: SELECT tag, c_tiny, typeof(c_tiny) AS cls FROM probe_type WHERE tag LIKE 'tiny_%' ORDER BY tag

steps.label: boolean 列两种存储类并存计数
steps.sql: SELECT typeof(c_bool) AS cls, count(*) AS cnt FROM probe_type WHERE tag LIKE 'bool_%' GROUP BY typeof(c_bool)

steps.label: datetime 列各存储类计数
steps.sql: SELECT typeof(dt_col) AS cls, count(*) AS cnt FROM probe_dt WHERE dt_col IS NOT NULL GROUP BY typeof(dt_col)

steps.label: 中文默认排序结果（原样）
steps.sql: SELECT name FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name

steps.label: 中文 DESC 排序结果（原样）
steps.sql: SELECT name FROM probe_cn ORDER BY name DESC

steps.label: 复合 UNIQUE 最终落库行
steps.sql: SELECT rowid, goal_id, version_no FROM probe_uk ORDER BY rowid
